run.question:
Alertmanager alert PendingPodsDetected (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/otel-demo since 2026-11-17T09:34:57Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The PendingPodsDetected alert is explained by two pods that cannot be scheduled because their pod template carries a nodeSelector that matches no node. The only Pending pods in the cluster are otel-demo/ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and otel-demo/cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; both have spec.nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node} and PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable. None of the five nodes has kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node (the node hostnames are i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15, i-097278082719f10ba), so the kube-scheduler reports '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'. Those two pods are the surge pods of in-flight rollouts: Deployment ad scaled new ReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 0->1 at 09:34:00 and Deployment cart scaled cart-5b597c6db5 0->1 at 09:34:08, ~1 minute before the alert opened at 09:34:57. Both Deployments' pod templates (generation 2, revision 2, Helm-managed release otel-demo) contain the same bogus nodeSelector, and they are the only two Deployments cluster-wide with it; their predecessor ReplicaSets and pods have no nodeSelector and the same image tag, i.e. this is a configuration-only template change. Impact observed is limited to those two pods: the predecessor pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p are still Running/Ready and both Deployments report availableReplicas=1, readyReplicas=1, unavailableReplicas=1, so no serving outage was observed. The ad service's sporadic STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans (about 1.11 per 5m window) are present from ~08:51, well before 09:34, and are treated as background. Who or what applied revision 2 (the Helm release secret) cannot be read. Naming Deployment ad in otel-demo as the root cause object is a choice between two equally-positioned objects: Deployment cart carries the identical fault and is affected the same way.

claims.text: The only Pending pods in the cluster are otel-demo/ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and otel-demo/cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; both have PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable and both carry spec.nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node}. The pod listing for otel-demo also shows exactly these two pods in phase Pending with node <none>.

No node carries kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node: the five nodes are i-01a47734339426210 (control-plane, taint node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule), i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 and i-097278082719f10ba, all with Ready=True, no unschedulable flag and allocatable cpu 4 / memory ~16Gi.

The scheduler's own message for both pods is (count 3 each, last at 2026-11-17T09:44:23Z): '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/5 nodes are available: 5 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.'

The pending pods are rollout surge pods: Deployment ad scaled new ReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 from 0 to 1 (event at 2026-11-17T09:34:00Z) which created pod ad-dd7f45975-mw86p, and Deployment cart scaled new ReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 from 0 to 1 (2026-11-17T09:34:08Z) which created pod cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh - both about a minute before the alert start 09:34:57Z.

Deployment otel-demo/ad has spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node}, metadata.generation 2, deployment revision 2, Helm annotations meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo, container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, and status availableReplicas=1, readyReplicas=1, replicas=2, unavailableReplicas=1 with Progressing reason ReplicaSetUpdated (lastUpdateTime 09:34:00Z).

Deployment otel-demo/cart carries the identical fault: spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node}, generation 2, revision 2, Helm release otel-demo, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart, status availableReplicas=1, readyReplicas=1, replicas=2, unavailableReplicas=1 with Progressing reason ReplicaSetUpdated (lastUpdateTime 09:34:08Z).

Cluster-wide, only the two otel-demo Deployments ad and cart have a pod-template nodeSelector of kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node; the other Deployments with a nodeSelector use kubernetes.io/os=linux (ingress-nginx-controller, cilium-operator, coredns, coredns-autoscaler, ebs-csi-controller, opentelemetry-operator).

The new ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 (owner Deployment ad) and cart-5b597c6db5 (owner Deployment cart) each have replicas=1, no readyReplicas, nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node}, and use the same image tags as their predecessors (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and :2.1.3-cart), while the predecessor ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 and cart-755465879b have readyReplicas=1 and no nodeSelector - a configuration-only template change.

The predecessor pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p have no nodeSelector and are Running/Ready (Ready=True, ContainersReady=True, node i-037e40963128cbd9f), unlike the Pending pods which have only a PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable condition and no node assignment.

The ad service shows a low, intermittent level of error-status spans (increase of ~1.11 per 5m window) that is already present from about 08:51 and repeats through 09:40, i.e. both before and after the 09:34 rollout, so it does not begin with this alert; cart returned no error-status series in the same query.

Serving capacity was not lost for either workload: Deployments ad and cart both report availableReplicas=1 and readyReplicas=1 while the surge pod is unavailable (unavailableReplicas=1), and their Services ad and cart still select the running pods via opentelemetry.io/name labels.

The nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node} was introduced into both pod templates by the same change - the Helm release otel-demo revision 2 applied at ~09:34 (both Deployments went to generation 2 / revision 2 within 8 seconds). The change source itself (Helm release secret / values) is unreadable, so this attribution rests on the shared timing and identical selector value.

Insufficient cluster capacity or node taint pressure is not the cause of the Pending state: the scheduler message names the affinity/selector mismatch on 4 nodes (the only taint mentioned is the control-plane taint, present for every pod), and all five nodes report Ready=True with 4 cpu and ~16Gi memory allocatable.

The pending pods are not a scaling (replica-count) event: the events record new ReplicaSet creation and 'Scaled up replica set ad-dd7f45975 from 0 to 1' / 'cart-5b597c6db5 from 0 to 1', i.e. a pod-template rollout, and the new ReplicaSets carry the new nodeSelector that the predecessors lack.

The FailedScheduling events for pods jaeger-traces-recorder-0 and prometheus-alert-recorder-0 in namespace data-recorders are unrelated to this alert: they are in a different namespace, their message is a VolumeBinding pre-bind PVC conflict ('the object has been modified; please apply your changes to the latest version and try again'), and no data-recorders pod is in the cluster's Pending list.

The ad error spans are not impact of this alert: the error increase is already present from ~08:51 (before the 09:34 rollout) and stays at the same ~1.11 per 5m level afterwards, so it is background not tied to the pending pods.

Remove the bogus nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node from the pod templates of Deployments ad and cart (or set it to a hostname that actually exists, e.g. one of i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15, i-097278082719f10ba) or remove it entirely, then let the rollouts complete so the Pending pods ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh can be scheduled; check the Helm values used for release otel-demo revision 2 for the source of that value.

gaps: No kube-state-metrics series are present in this Prometheus: get_metric_names {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned nothing, so kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready / pending-pod metrics could not be used to measure the Pending state over time; deployment status here comes from the kube API objects only.
The alerting rule PendingPodsDetected was not found by list_prometheus_rules, so the rule expression and the exact 2-pod count over time could not be verified in this Prometheus.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who/what applied the revision-2 pod template (Helm release otel-demo) could not be determined; Helm stores its release metadata in Secrets, which cannot be read, and no ConfigMap containing 'invalid-node' was found.
No ConfigMap in any namespace contains the string 'invalid-node' (query returned no matching object), so the value's source object is not visible as a ConfigMap.

Application logs: fetch_pod_logs on ad-554b849958-42mdm with the error filter returned status no_data (2808 lines read, none matched), which does not prove the absence of errors; logs of the running cart pod cart-755465879b-bgb2p were not read, and the two Pending pods have no containers yet, so no application logs exist for them.
traces_search for service ad over 09:20-09:49:42 returned no traces (backend returned 0), so ad's request-level behavior in the incident window could not be inspected from traces.
Whether Deployment cart emits its own error signals was not established: the error-status increase query returned no cart error series, which is an unknown value, not a verified zero.
next_steps: Diff the Helm values / chart revision 2 for release otel-demo to find where nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node entered the ad and cart pod templates, and revert that value.
After the pod templates are corrected, confirm the rollouts of Deployment ad and Deployment cart progress and that ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh are replaced by schedulable pods.
Have a human review the running cart pod's logs and per-service error/latency dashboards for the 09:34-09:50 window, since the log and trace evidence for cart could not be gathered here.
